messages:
Maya: Heads-up: saw a regression on qwen2.5 in prod after the recent ropescale tweak. latency p50 jumped ~18% on long-chat workload.
Choi: ugh. which route/model? any easy repro?
Maya: channel=chat-gen-qwen2p5, model=qwen2.5-32k-rope-v2, traffic spike ~2am. Repro locally with batch=8, seq=2048.
Andre: sharing profiler snapshot, kernel switch occurred at token 512 -> moved from cuda_fused_attn to generic_kernel, huge perf hit.
Andre: profiler snippet:
```
kernel: cuda_fused_attn
input_len: 512
switch_to: generic_attention
reason: kv_head_dim_mismatch
```
Ravi: kv_head_dim_mismatch... did we change kv projection dims when enabling ropescale v2?
Lina: I think rope scaling changed head split math for multi-lang tokens, tokenizer can produce extra tokens for CJK -> shifts kv indexing.
Maya: +1. repro shows misaligned kv offsets when tokenizer splits differently. p95 latency spike correlates with token boundary events.
Choi: can you paste the minimal repro script?
Lina: paste below:
```
# repro
python perf_repro.py --model qwen2.5-32k-rope-v2 --batch 8 --seq 2048 --seed 42
# compare kernels
cat /tmp/prof.json | jq '.events | map(select(.name=="kernel_switch"))'
```
perf-bot: ALERT qwen2p5-ropescale-regress cpu_time +1200ms at 2002501236
Andre: note: kernel selection logic picks kernel if kv_dim == head_dim * something; our check uses floor div for ropescale ratios; small tokenizer changes can change rounding -> mismatch.
Ravi: experiment idea: fallback to ALiBi-compatible kernel when head/kv dims mismatch until we fix kv projection math. cheap guard.
Choi: also try forcing continuous batching heuristic to prefer small batches for these token-boundary-heavy requests.
Maya: teams: can we run two quick experiments on staging:
- Lina: run ropescale-v2 with kv-proj-fix patch (branch: kv-align-fix)
- Andre: enable ALiBi-fallback flag on runtime (flag: runtime.alibi_fallback=true)
- Ravi: tweak batcher: max_batch_tokens=16384 for route chat-gen-qwen2p5
Lina: running kv-align-fix now, will post results.
Andre: I'll roll alibi_fallback to staging in 15.
Ravi: I'll update batching config and monitor.
Maya: thanks. assign owners: Lina (repro + patch), Andre (runtime flag), Ravi (batcher). Check back in ~1h. :thumbsup:
Lina: quick note: tokenizer edge-case log attached: tokenization for "北京大学" -> 4 tokens vs expected 3 in old tokenizer.
Maya: ok good, that explains shifts. we should also add a unit test to tokenization bench for multilang boundaries.
perf-bot: METRICS staging: baseline p50=92ms -> rollout p50=112ms after alibi_fallback test started (2002501300)
Choi: will do deep dive if experiments don't recover perf.
Maya: thanks everyone. closing loop once staging green.
